# clickhouse_notification_types (Data Source)

~> **Note:** This data source is in beta.

Use the *clickhouse_notification_types* data source to list the notification types the organization can receive. It is the registry a `clickhouse_notification_settings` rule names types from, read at plan time, so a type added to ClickHouse Cloud needs no provider release.

Types the organization is not entitled to are omitted. A type the API key lacks the permission for is still listed, with `is_available` set to false.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "clickhouse_notification_types" "all" {}

# Only a configurable type can carry a rule; a rule naming any other is rejected.
output "configurable_service_notifications" {
  value = [
    for t in data.clickhouse_notification_types.all.types : t.name
    if t.is_configurable && t.resource_type == "service"
  ]
}
```

Drive a rule set from the registry rather than a hard-coded list:

```hcl
resource "clickhouse_notification_settings" "alice_critical" {
  user_id  = data.clickhouse_user.alice.id
  channels = ["email"]

  rules = [
    {
      effect = "enabled"
      notifications = [
        for t in data.clickhouse_notification_types.all.types : t.name
        if t.severity == "critical" && t.is_configurable && t.resource_type == "service"
      ]
      resources = [clickhouse_service.prod.id]
    },
  ]
}
```

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "clickhouse_notification_types" "all" {}

# Only a configurable type can carry a rule; a rule naming any other is rejected.
output "configurable_service_notifications" {
  value = [
    for t in data.clickhouse_notification_types.all.types : t.name
    if t.is_configurable && t.resource_type == "service"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `types` (Attributes List) Notification types the organization is entitled to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--types))

<a id="nestedatt--types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `types`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Broad grouping the notification type belongs to, such as 'billing' or 'service'. New values may be added over time.
- `description` (String) Longer explanation of what the notification reports. Empty for types that have none.
- `is_available` (Boolean) False when the API key reading this data source lacks the permission the type requires. The type is still listed, just flagged.
- `is_configurable` (Boolean) Whether the delivery default can be changed. A rule naming a type that is not configurable is rejected. False does not mean the notification is always delivered.
- `name` (String) Stable identifier of the notification type, as used in a clickhouse_notification_settings rule. Never renamed or reused.
- `resource_type` (String) Kind of resource a notification of this type is about, which is the kind of ID a rule naming this type takes. New values may be added over time.
- `severity` (String) Relative importance of notifications of this type: 'info', 'warning' or 'critical'.
- `title` (String) Human-readable name of the notification type.
